name: Córdoba
assessment: Official Dirección General del Catastro custody and Córdoba territorial-office catalog evidence were verified. The documented public INSPIRE WFS returned a bounded Córdoba-area parcel response with native cadastral identities and polygon geometry. Runtime remains held pending serial review.
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Spanish discovery was performed. The official INSPIRE catalog identified WFS and ATOM services; the ATOM catalog explicitly listed Territorial Office 14 Córdoba and municipality 14900-CORDOBA. A tiny EPSG:4326 test returned no records, while the same local area in the source CRS EPSG:25830 returned 343 records in HTTP 200 GML. The server ignored count=3, so only three polygons were retained.
